title: Testing a new cash secured puts/covered call automated trading app
author: eguilesjr
selftext: I recently built an automated WHEEL trading platform that calculates a Z-score gauging IV market-wide rather than by individual stocks, which creates three tiers — ACTIVE, REDUCED, and PAUSED — to guide entry timing and position sizing. I’m currently paper trading a $1 million portfolio. If you’re interested I’m glad to share a link to the website.
